# audio

ALSA microphone helpers for when the mic has stopped working again.

---

## `audio_mic_to_speaker`

Pipe the microphone straight to the speakers. Runs until Ctrl-C. Wear headphones unless you enjoy feedback.

**Usage**

```sh
audio_mic_to_speaker
```

**Examples**

```sh
audio_mic_to_speaker
```

**Requires** `arecord`, `aplay`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/audio.sh:52`](../../modules/linux/audio.sh#L52)

**See also** `https://askubuntu.com/a/887658`

---

## `audio_record_mic`

Record from the default input to a temporary WAV and print its path.

**Usage**

```sh
audio_record_mic [seconds]
```

**Examples**

```sh
audio_record_mic 10
```

**Requires** `arecord`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/audio.sh:13`](../../modules/linux/audio.sh#L13)

---

## `audio_test_mic`

Record a short clip, play it straight back, then delete it. The quickest way to tell whether the mic is alive.

**Usage**

```sh
audio_test_mic [seconds]
```

**Examples**

```sh
audio_test_mic 5
```

**Requires** `arecord`, `aplay`

**OS** Linux only &nbsp;·&nbsp; **Source** [`modules/linux/audio.sh:32`](../../modules/linux/audio.sh#L32)
